recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中細胞極多，以大小一致、核圓至卵圓、細胞質淡藍且邊界不清的單核細胞為主，彼此間距規則，取代正常多樣的造血細胞，符合毛細胞白血病的單一形態浸潤；此倍率下看不到毛狀突起。
features: Hypercellular aspirate at low power with a monotonous mononuclear cell population
Small-to-medium cells with round to oval nuclei and evenly dispersed chromatin
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm with indistinct borders giving evenly spaced nuclei
Marked reduction of granulocytic and erythroid maturation
Dark marrow particle and a megakaryocyte at lower left; numerous fat spaces
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low magnification is hypercellular and dominated by a monotonous population of small to medium-sized mononuclear cells with round to oval nuclei and moderate pale cytoplasm with indistinct borders, producing evenly spaced nuclei. Normal granulocytic and erythroid maturation is markedly diminished; a marrow particle and a megakaryocyte are present at the lower left. Cytoplasmic hairy projections cannot be resolved at this magnification, so correlation with higher-power morphology, flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) and BRAF V600E is needed. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by hairy cell leukemia; note that many cases yield a dry tap, making an aspirate like this less typical.

ddx.vs: SMZL cells have more condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm and are CD103/CD25/annexin A1-negative.
CLL cells are small with coarse block-like chromatin and scant cytoplasm, and are CD5+/CD23+ rather than CD103+.
Blasts have finer chromatin, higher N:C ratio and visible nucleoli, and express CD34 or TdT rather than a mature B-cell phenotype.
Mast cells contain abundant metachromatic granules and express CD117 and tryptase.
